```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, cache = T, fig.width=8, fig.height=4)
options(scipen = 0, digits = 3)  # controls base R output
if(!require('pacman')) {
  install.packages('pacman')
}
pacman::p_load(ggplot2, dplyr, tidyverse, gridExtra, ggrepel, plotly, skimr, tidytext, stringr, here)
# install a package if it does not exist already and put the package in the path (library)
# dplyr, ggplot2,tidyr
library(plotly)
dir.create(here("data", "processed"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

```{r}
data_weather <- read.csv(here("data", "processed", "rain_data.csv"), header = TRUE, na.strings = c(""))
data_disaster <- read.csv(here("data", "raw", "emdat_data.csv"), header = TRUE)
disaster_states <- read.csv(here("data", "processed", "states_extracted.csv"), header = TRUE) %>%
  select(States)
```

```{r}
data_disaster_binded <-  bind_cols(data_disaster, disaster_states)
data_disaster_binded <- data_disaster_binded %>% drop_na(Start.Year, Start.Month, Start.Day)
data_weather <- data_weather %>%
  mutate(Date = as.Date(paste(Year, Month, Day, sep = "-")))
```
```{r}
data_disaster_rain <- data_disaster_binded %>%
  filter(Disaster.Type %in% c("Storm"))

start_dates <- data_disaster_rain %>%
  select(Start.Year,Start.Month,Start.Day,Disaster.Type,States) %>%
  mutate(
    Start.Year = as.character(Start.Year),
    Start.Month = str_pad(as.character(Start.Month), 2, pad = "0"),
    Start.Day = str_pad(as.character(Start.Day), 2, pad = "0"),
    Start.Date = as.Date(paste(Start.Year, Start.Month, Start.Day, sep = "-"))
    )
```

```{r}

# Remove first 10 days
min_date <- min(data_weather$Date, na.rm = TRUE)
data_weather_filtered <- data_weather %>%
  filter(Date > min_date + 11)

# Get unique dates (if you want to do this for each unique date)
unique_dates <- sort(unique(data_weather_filtered$Date))

# Create a data frame with 10-day vectors for each date
date_lookback_df <- data.frame(
  CurrentDate = unique_dates,
  Last10Days = I(lapply(unique_dates, function(x) seq(x - 10, x - 1, by = "day")))
)
```

```{r}

# Assume date_lookback_df has a Location column
# Create a reference set of disaster dates per location
disaster_events <- start_dates %>%
  select(Start.Date, States, Disaster.Type) %>%
  distinct()

write.csv(disaster_events, file = here("data", "processed", "disaster_events.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

# Split the comma-separated states into individual rows
disaster_events_long <- disaster_events %>%
  separate_rows(States, sep = ",\\s*") %>%  # removes spaces around commas
  rename(State = States)
  
```

```{r}

data_weather_daily <- data_weather %>%
  group_by(Location,Date) %>%
  summarize(
    DailyPrecipitation = sum(HourlyPrecipitation),
    AverageAltimeterSetting = mean(HourlyAltimeterSetting),
    AverageStationPressure = mean(HourlyStationPressure),
    TotalPressureChange = sum(HourlyPressureChange),
    AverageWetBulbTemp = mean(HourlyWetBulbTemperature),
    AverageDryBulbTemp = mean(HourlyDryBulbTemperature),
    AverageDewPointTemp = mean(HourlyDewPointTemperature),
    AverageRelativeHumidity = mean(HourlyRelativeHumidity),
    AverageWindSpeed = mean(HourlyWindSpeed)
            )
```

```{r}
# Join disaster state info to weather data (if not already state-specific)
# Assuming 'Location' in data_weather_daily refers to State
weather_chunks <- list()

for (i in seq_len(nrow(date_lookback_df))) {
  current_date <- date_lookback_df$CurrentDate[i]
  past_10_days <- date_lookback_df$Last10Days[[i]]
  
  # Filter weather data to the 10 days
  chunk <- data_weather_daily %>%
    filter(Date %in% past_10_days) %>%
    mutate(CurrentDate = current_date)
  
  weather_chunks[[i]] <- chunk
}

# Combine all chunks into one dataframe
weather_10day <- bind_rows(weather_chunks)


```


```{r}

# Prepare for labeling
disaster_events_long <- disaster_events_long %>%
  select(Start.Date, State) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  mutate(Label = 1)


# Add label to weather_10day
weather_labeled <- weather_10day %>%
  left_join(disaster_events_long, by = c("CurrentDate" = "Start.Date", "Location" = "State")) %>%
  mutate(Label = ifelse(is.na(Label), 0, Label))
```
```{r}

weather_wide <- weather_labeled %>%
  arrange(Location, CurrentDate, Date) %>%
  group_by(Location, CurrentDate, Label) %>%
  mutate(day_lag = row_number()) %>%  # assigns 1 to 10
  ungroup()

# Now pivot to wide format: variables x day
weather_wide_pivot <- weather_wide %>%
  select(Location, CurrentDate, Label, day_lag,
         DailyPrecipitation, AverageAltimeterSetting, AverageStationPressure,
         TotalPressureChange, AverageWetBulbTemp, AverageDryBulbTemp,
         AverageDewPointTemp, AverageRelativeHumidity, AverageWindSpeed) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = day_lag,
    values_from = c(DailyPrecipitation, AverageAltimeterSetting, AverageStationPressure,
                    TotalPressureChange, AverageWetBulbTemp, AverageDryBulbTemp,
                    AverageDewPointTemp, AverageRelativeHumidity, AverageWindSpeed),
    names_sep = "_day"
  )

skim(weather_wide_pivot)

write.csv(weather_wide_pivot, here("data", "processed", "weather_wide_pivot.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

```
